name: Kenzan!! Momo-chan Zamurai
source:
Heroine of justice "Momo-chan Zamurai" defeats all kinds of evil underlings one by one in quiz battles. But when she loses and gets insulted, can she arise and condemn evil as before?

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
正义女主角“桃子武士”在问答战斗中逐个击败各类邪恶手下。然而，当她落败并遭受羞辱后，还能重新站起来，像从前一样制裁邪恶吗？

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
